meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: Claude 会从目录、URL、粘贴的笔记或刚才的对话中提炼出可复用的技能,写成 .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md;若已有同名技能则就地更新。它只创建或改进技能,不安装现成技能。
howto.when: 当你输入 “/learn” 等指令,要求把某个来源(目录、URL、笔记等)变成技能,或改进已有技能时接管。它只管创建和改进,不负责安装现成技能。

say.note: 会抓取该页面并生成新技能。

say.text: /learn 把我们刚才的操作流程存成技能
say.note: 把本次对话步骤提炼成 SKILL.md。

say.text: 更新 wow-on-steam-deck 技能,加入新发现
say.note: 就地修改已有技能,而非新建。

howto.what_en: Claude distills a reusable skill from a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the work just done, writing or updating .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. It creates or refines skills; it does not install existing ones.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type '/learn', ask it to turn a source (directory, URL, notes, or the last conversation) into a skill, or to refine an existing one. It creates/refines only; never installs.

say_en.text: /learn https://example.com/docs — turn this into a skill
say_en.note: Fetches the page and writes a new skill.

say_en.text: /learn what we just did — make it a skill
Update the wow-on-steam-deck skill with new findings
say_en.note: Edits the existing skill in place.
